system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

data_description.dataset_name: Geomorpho90m First order derivatives: Compound Topographic Index (CTI)

spatial_coverage.region_name: Global geomorphometric compound topographic index coverage
spatial_coverage.coverage: Global Geomorpho90m CTI dataset in WGS84, organized as spatial tiles rather than a single monolithic raster.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Static geomorphometric CTI tile collection derived from MERIT DEM; each image represents a spatial terrain tile rather than a time step.
data_description.temporal_unit: Not a temporal series; spatial tiles only

band_semantics.b1: Compound Topographic Index (CTI) raster for the spatial tile encoded by `system:index`.

data_description.important_note: Description fields below were populated from an actual Earth Engine ImageCollection probe. The collection is organized as spatial CTI tiles, not as a dated time series.

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Compound Topographic Index (also known as Topographic Wetness Index) values; higher values indicate areas with higher moisture accumulation potential.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Treat `system:index` values as tile identifiers and `pixel_resolution` as the spatial-resolution cue.

data_description.data_source: Yale University, Coillte, Irish State Forestry Board, Leibniz-Institute of Freshwater Ecology and Inland Fisheries, European Commission - Joint Research Centre, Spatial Ecology via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
